T006 writes string 'Unavailable' into ari/nmi and columns `silhouette_score,optimal_resolution` not in the schema. As specified, the verification command cannot deterministically pass; the task must either define a concrete row-to-JSON conversion + a row-level schema, or drop the schema-validation claim and use a programmatic check.

'every numeric literal in the Results section traces to combined_metrics.parquet or the JSON artifacts (spot-check by grep)' is not a deterministic check — grep cannot establish traceability of arbitrary numbers. Name a concrete verification, e.g. a `code/tests/test_summary_numbers.py` that extracts numeric literals from paper/summary.md and asserts each appears in the parquet/JSON values, or restrict the claim to specific listed quantities.
